title: Verpleegkundige thuisverpleging (Buggenhout)
description:
Als thuisverpleegkundige ben je een waardevolle zorgverlener voor jouw patiënten, in hun vertrouwde thuisomgeving. Het persoonlijk contact maakt thuisverpleging tot een heel dankbare job.Ben jij een (basis)verpleegkundige met een hart voor je patiënten en een passie voor je job? Dan ben jij de persoon die we zoeken!Wat ga je doen?Als verpleegkundige in de thuiszorg heb je een heel gevarieerd takenpakket: inspuitingen geven, medicatie toedienen, wondverzorging, hygiënische zorgen, geavanceerde verpleegtechnieken toepassen, ...De functie van thuisverpleegkundige verschilt met andere jobs als verpleegkundige of basisverpleegkundige om diverse redenen:
  • Het persoonlijk contact met je patiënt maakt thuisverpleging tot een heel dankbare job;
  • Je komt terecht in een geïntegreerd zorgteam bestaande uit zorgcoördinator, verzorgende, maatschappelijk assistent, poetshulp en vrijwilligers;
  • Minder administratie! Verpleegdossiers handel je snel en efficiënt af via je tablet;
  • Verplaatsing met eigen bedrijfswagen in eigen streek.
Te mooi om waar te zijn? Wij overtuigen je graag in een persoonlijk gesprek van de vele voordelen die je als verpleegkundige in de thuiszorg mag ervaren.
  • Diploma verpleegkunde (Bachelor, HBO5 of basisverpleegkundige) of vroedkunde (indien uitgereikt vóór oktober 2018);
  • Sociaal geëngageerd zijn;
  • Jouw topprioriteit: het welzijn van je patiënt;
  • Duidelijke en correcte communicatie met patiënt en leidinggevende;
  • Correcte verwerking van administratie;
  • Bereidheid om 1 weekend op 2 te werken;
  • Rijbewijs B.

title: Supervisor maaltijdverdeling en vaatwas
description:
Wil jij leiding geven aan een enthousiast team dat elke dag topmaaltijden bereidt voor onze patiënten? Als supervisor maaltijdverdeling en vaatwas ben je het aanspreekpunt voor de ploeg die instaat voor portionering van de maaltijden en vaatwas. Je zorgt voor een efficiënte organisatie, motiveert je team en bouwt mee aan een kwaliteitsvolle en warme eetervaring in het ziekenhuis.  Wat zijn jouw taken? 	 - Je verdeelt dagelijks de taken van het team portionering en vaatwas	 - Je past de voedingsregels toe	 - Je zorgt voor de maaltijdadministratie	 - Je werkt mee waar nodig	 - Je begeleidt en coacht de medewerkers	 - Je introduceert nieuwe medewerkers	 - Je past het dienstrooster aan bij wijzigingen in de personeelsbezetting
 	 - Je hebt een grote interesse voor de boeiende wereld van een ziekenhuiskeuken	 - Je kijkt er naar uit om je schouders te zetten onder een grote uitdaging om alles m.b.t. onze vaatwas en portionering zo optimaal mogelijk te laten verlopen	 - Je kan vlot overweg met de courante Office toepassingen	 - Je bent communicatief sterk, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk	 - Je kan medewerkers enthousiasmeren, motiveren en hen begeleiden tot optimale prestaties	 - Je kan zaken goed organiseren en prioriteiten stellen. Een wijziging in planning brengt je niet van je stuk maar je zet alles op alles om alles terug op wieltjes te laten lopen	 - Je houdt ervan op nieuwe collega’s op te leiden en hen de kneepjes van het vak te leren	 - Je deinst er niet voor terug om zelf ook de handen uit de mouwen te steken en mee te helpen waar nodig

title: Polyvalent Medewerker
description:
Ben je een vroege vogel met een warm hart voor gastvrijheid? Werk je graag in een rustige en inspirerende omgeving waar persoonlijke aandacht centraal staat? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Sarephta is een charmante B&B, gevestigd in het klooster van de Paters Karmelieten in Brugge. Voor de ondersteuning van onze dagelijkse werking zoeken wij een enthousiaste en veelzijdige medewerker. Jouw takenJe ondersteunt onze gasten en collega's bij verschillende dagelijkse werkzaamheden: • klaarzetten van het ontbijt voor de gasten • Opdienen, afruimen en netjes houden van de ontbijtruimte • Ondersteuning in de keuken bij afwezigheid van de kok • Schoonmaken en aanvullen van de ontbijtzaal • Sporadisch poetsen en klaarmaken van de gastenkamers • Mee zorgen voor een warme, nette en gastvrije omgeving voor onze gasten

Wij zoeken een collega die: • Vriendelijk, sociaal en gastvrij is • Sterk is in communicatie • Een verzorgd en professioneel voorkomen heeft • Zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband kan werken • Nederlands en Engels vlot beheerst • Oog heeft voor orde, netheid en detail • Flexibel en betrouwbaar is • Open mind voor een spirituele werkomgeving

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Account Management & Business Development

  • Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
  • Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
  • Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
  • Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.

Commercial & Performance Management

  • Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
  • Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
  • Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.

Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

  • Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
  • Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
  • Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.

Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

  • Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
  • Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
  • Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
  • Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.
  • Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
  • Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
  • Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
  • Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
  • Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
  • Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics

title: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

  • A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
  • An international and multilingual setting
  • An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
  • A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

  • Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
  • Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
  • Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
  • Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
  • Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)

Access and security

  • Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
  • Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)

Hardware and lifecycle

  • Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
  • Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
  • Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
  • Tickets, escalation and coordination
  • Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
  • Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
  • Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
  • Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
  • Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)

You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
  • At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
  • Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
  • Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
  • Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity

Assets

  • Knowledge of Arabic
  • Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
  • Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
  • IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)

Soft skills

  • Customer focus and service mindset
  • Autonomy and rigour in incident management
  • Clear communication with non-technical users
  • Hands-on, proactive attitude

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
An leading independent law firm based in Brussels and London is searching for an administrative assistant.

Jobomschrijving

As a trilingual Administrative Assistant, you are the seamless link between teams, clients and leaders — elevating communication, efficiency and collaboration across every

Document & Information Management

Create, format and refine documents and timesheets with accuracy and attention to detail.

Update and maintain the contact database to ensure flawless information flow.

Edit and manage office floorplans when needed.

Meetings & Events Coordination

Organize meetings and conference calls, ensuring smooth logistics from start to finish.

Provide support for both internal and external events, contributing to their seamless execution.

Reception Support

Act as backup for reception:

Second floor: during lunch breaks, holidays and receptionist absences.

First floor: during client meetings.

You’re a sharp, fast-moving administrative powerhouse who keeps everything — and everyone — on track. Fully fluent in English, French and Dutch, you switch between languages with ease, making communication smooth and effortless across the entire organization.

You love bringing order to chaos: calendars run better, documents look sharper, and operations flow smoother because you’re behind them. Detail-driven but always thinking two steps ahead, you anticipate needs before they appear and handle challenges with confidence and positivity.

People count on you because you deliver — with efficiency, professionalism and a smile.

You’re proactive, reliable and naturally service-minded, making you the go-to person for both colleagues and clients. In short: you’re the kind of assistant who makes the whole office work better.

title: Office Manager
description:
This company is a worlwide professional association of service operators located in Brussel. 

Jobomschrijving

Database

•    Check the recorded data and update daily with more accurate information according to the different status and categories of interest. •    Harmonize data records.•    Regular cleaning of old data.•    Actively seek to contact our Members to develop/expand our database with useful contacts (Commercial Directors, Finance Directors, HR Directors…).  •    Provide regular input to improve existing and future tool. •    Close cooperation with the company's World database coordinator

Administration Travel

Provide full administrative support including travel arrangements and expenses reports to the Media & Communications department.

Send press releases.

title: Centrumleider
description:
Breng buurtgerichte zorg tot leven

Als centrumleider geef je de dagelijkse werking van het dienstencentrum vorm. Je bouwt aan een warme, toegankelijke plek waar buurtbewoners, gebruikers, vrijwilligers en partners elkaar ontmoeten en ondersteuning vinden.

Je organiseert een relevant aanbod rond ontmoeting, ondersteuning en buurtgerichte zorg. Je detecteert noden, neemt signalen op en verwijst gericht door naar de juiste dienstverlening.

Daarnaast stuur je medewerkers en vrijwilligers aan, ondersteun je hen in hun werking en versterk je samenwerkingen met collega’s en lokale partners.

Je volgt administratie, planning, rapportering en financiële processen op en bewaakt de kwaliteit en continuïteit van de werking.

Je maakt deel uit van het team buurt- en mantelzorg en rapporteert aan de teamcoach buurt- en mantelzorg.

Wat maakt werken bij ons bijzonder?

  • Je krijgt ruimte om initiatieven uit te werken die inspelen op wat leeft in de buurt.
  • Je combineert leidinggeven, organiseren en verbinden in één veelzijdige functie.
  • Je draagt bij aan warme zorg, sociale verbinding en langer kwaliteitsvol thuis wonen.

We beschikken momenteel over een openstaande plaats in DC De Vuurkorf in Beveren 

Wie zoeken we?

Een centrumleider die mensen verbindt, overzicht bewaart en buurtgerichte zorg op een warme manier mee vormgeeft.

Je communiceert verbindend, duidelijk en professioneel met verschillende doelgroepen.

Je werkt gestructureerd en houdt overzicht in planning, opvolging en samenwerking.

Je beweegt soepel mee met veranderingen in zorg, welzijn en buurtwerking.

Jouw competenties maken het verschil

We zoeken een centrumleider die:

  • samenwerkt met gebruikers, vrijwilligers, collega’s, thuiszorg, woonzorg en lokale partners om buurtgerichte zorg te versterken.
  • initiatief neemt door noden, kansen en knelpunten tijdig te signaleren en om te zetten in concrete acties.
  • klantgericht werkt vanuit de vragen, mogelijkheden en noden van gebruikers en buurtbewoners.
  • overtuigt en draagvlak creëert bij medewerkers, vrijwilligers en partners.
  • resultaatgericht werkt aan een kwaliteitsvolle, toegankelijke en duurzame werking van het dienstencentrum.
  • coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en vrijwilligers door te ondersteunen, feedback te geven en leerkansen te stimuleren.
  • creatief meedenkt over initiatieven, samenwerkingen en oplossingen die aansluiten bij de buurt.
  • beslissingen neemt met aandacht voor impact, haalbaarheid en de continuïteit van de werking.
  • veranderingsgericht handelt en soepel inspeelt op nieuwe noden, afspraken en ontwikkelingen.
  • netwerkt doelgericht binnen en buiten de organisatie om de werking van het dienstencentrum verder te versterken.

Jouw sleutel tot deze job?

  • Je beschikt over een bachelordiploma, bij voorkeur in het studiegebied sociaal-agogisch werk of gezondheidszorg.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om buurtgerichte zorg zichtbaar, toegankelijk en warm vorm te geven.
  • Je combineert organisatorische sterkte met verbindend leiderschap en een hart voor mensen.
  • Je werkt vlot met digitale toepassingen en volgt administratie, rapportering en procedures zorgvuldig op.
  • Je blijft graag bijleren en denkt actief mee over vernieuwing binnen zorg, welzijn en buurtwerking.

title: General Secretary/Chief of Staff
description:
Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.Key ResponsibilitiesGovernance, Legal & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
  • Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
  • Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

  • Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
  • Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

  • Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
  • Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
  • Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

  • Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

  • Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
  • Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
  • Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

  • Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
  • Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

ProfileWe are looking for someone who:

  • Holds a Master's degree in Law.
  • Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
  • Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
  • Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
  • Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
  • Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
  • Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
  • Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
  • Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

title: IT Coordinator
description:
Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
  • Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
  • Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
  • Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
  • Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.

IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

  • Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
  • Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
  • Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
  • Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
  • Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.

Project Management & Product Ownership

  • Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
  • Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
  • Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.

IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

  • Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
  • Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
  • Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
  • Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
  • Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
  • Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
  • Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
  • Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

description:
Drømmer du om nye oplevelser, internationale kolleger og en hverdag i en spændende europæisk storby? Så har du nu muligheden for at kombinere et fast job med et nyt kapitel i Sofia!

Sofia byder på det bedste fra flere verdener: et levende byliv med hyggelige caféer, gode restauranter, kultur og et internationalt miljø. Samtidig får du en overkommelig leveomkostning, smuk natur lige uden for byen og gode muligheder for at udforske resten af Europa.

Vi varetager rekrutteringen til stillingen, og ansættelsen sker direkte hos vores kunde i Bulgarien.

 

Om jobbet

Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejdere til en international virksomhed i Sofia.

Du bliver en del af et multikulturelt team, hvor du hjælper dansktalende kunder over telefonen med spørgsmål om mobilabonnementer og forskellige services.

Stillingen er uden salg, og tidligere erfaring med kundeservice er ikke et krav. Du får grundig oplæring, så du er godt klædt på til jobbet.

 

Hvad kan du se frem til?

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling med arbejdstid mandag–fredag kl. 10.00–19.00

  • Attraktiv lønpakke set i forhold til det lokale lønniveau samt mulighed for bonus.

  • Relocation package med midlertidig bolig og økonomisk støtte til flytningen

  • Sundhedsforsikring og andre personalegoder

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med kolleger fra forskellige lande

  • Muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling

  • Fri i weekenderne til at opleve Sofia og resten af Bulgarien

 

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler dansk på et højt professionelt niveau og kan kommunikere på engelsk

  • Er serviceminded og trives med at tale med mennesker

  • Har lyst til at bo og arbejde i udlandet

  • Er nysgerrig, fleksibel og klar til nye oplevelser

Uanset om du er i starten af din karriere, ønsker et miljøskifte eller drømmer om at prøve noget helt nyt, kan dette være muligheden for dig.

 

Arbejdssted: Sofia, Bulgarien (arbejde fra kontoret)

Opstart: 30. november 2026

  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 2. studenog 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro
  • 1 collaboratore/collaboratrice professionale – pedagogista in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo determinato (supplenza) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici
CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformita' all'articolo 29, comma 1 a) del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20):
  • laurea
  • padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana
2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 2 novembre 2026.

title: KONOBAR M/Ž

title: TERENSKI SERVISER/KA
description:
Terenski serviser (m/ž)

Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti:

  • izvođenje servisnih radova u tvrtki i na terenu, na uređajima tvrtke RASCO i na ostalim uređajima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa i distribuira
  • remont strojeva preuzetih od kupaca
  • izvođenje osnovne obuke za upravljanje Rasco strojevima i uređajima, i onima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa
  • prijava nesukladnosti prikupljenih sa terena
  • unos podataka i korekcija u baze podataka kojima raspolaže servis
  • vođenje točnih zapisa vezanih za servisne radne naloge
  • kontrola tehničke ispravnosti i održavanje osobnih, dostavnih i teretnih vozila tvrtke

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • SSS tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, autoelektričar, elektromonter itd.)
  • Poželjno 1 - 3 godina radnog iskustvu u sličnim poslovima, ali razmotriti ćemo i kandidate bez radnog iskustva, a koji su spremni proći intenzivnu obuku namijenjenu serviserima početnicima
  • Engleski ili njemački jezik (osnovna razina)
  • Korištenje računalom i MS Office aplikacijama (osnovno)
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorija
  • Sklonost terenskom radu
  • Odgovoran pristup radnim zadacima
  • Sklonost timskom radu i fleksibilnost u poslu

Što nudimo:

  • Početnu plaću sukladno prethodnom iskustvu uz jasno definiranu mogućnost povećanja primanja nakon savladavanja zahtjeva radnog mjesta
  • Naknade troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla, dodatak za topli obrok i radne rezultate kao i isplata pripadajućih dnevnica i terenskog dodatka i prekovremenog rada na terenu
  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca
  • Mentora i sustavno praćenje napretka s ciljem osiguravanja podrške i uspješno uvođenje u posao
  • Dodatne edukacije vezane uz specifičnosti radnog mjesta i edukacije namijenjene osobnom razvoju
  • Radno okružje s visokom razinom odgovornosti te rad sa iskusnim stručnjacima u navedenom području

Mjesto rada: Kalinovac, Koprivničko-križevačka županija Molimo pošaljite nam svoju prijavu i životopis najkasnije do 30.11.2026. godine.

title: STROJAR/KA SUSTAVA GRIJANJA I HLAĐENJA

title: PRODAJNI/A SAVJETNIK/CA – PRODAJA SOLARNIH ELEKTRANA
description: TERENSKI/A PRODAJNI/A PREDSTAVNIK/CA ZA SOLARNE ELEKTRANE Green Bean traži prodajnu osobu za aktivno pronalaženje kupaca solarnih elektrana, prvenstveno vlasnika obiteljskih kuća. Kako izgleda posao? Glavninu rada čine terenski obilasci sela i manjih mjesta u okolici Zagreba. Obilazite dodijeljeno područje, neposredno pristupate vlasnicima kuća i započinjete razgovore o mogućnosti ugradnje solarne elektrane. Važan dio posla čine kontakti bez prethodno dogovorenog sastanka. Očekujemo da samostalno stvarate nove prodajne prilike te zainteresirane kupce pratite od prvog razgovora do ugovaranja. Glavni poslovi: • planiranje i obilazak dodijeljenog područja • osobno kontaktiranje vlasnika kuća i predstavljanje ponude • prepoznavanje interesa i prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu ponude • dogovaranje daljnjih sastanaka i tehničkih obilazaka • prezentacija ponuda te redoviti telefonski, e-mail i osobni kontakt s kupcima do njihove odluke • vođenje evidencije kontakata i prodajnih aktivnosti • suradnja s tehničkim i operativnim timom Koga tražimo? Osobu kojoj odgovara svakodnevni teren, koja može samostalno započeti razgovor s nepoznatom osobom i ustrajno pratiti prodajne prilike. Važno nam je kako pristupate kupcu, slušate njegove potrebe i postupate nakon odbijanja. Prednost imaju kandidati s dokazivim iskustvom u samostalnom pronalaženju i pridobivanju novih kupaca, osobito kroz neposrednu terensku prodaju. Iskustvo sa solarnim elektranama ili tehničkim proizvodima predstavlja prednost, ali nije uvjet. Osiguravamo edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i našem prodajnom procesu. Obavezni su vozačka dozvola B kategorije i spremnost na svakodnevnu vožnju i terenski rad. title: RADNIK NA ODRŽAVANJU - ELEKTRIČAR(M/Ž)
description:
O NAMA

Bjelin Ogulin 2 d.o.o. dio je hrvatsko-švedske Bjelin grupacije, jednog od vodećih europskih proizvođača inovativnih drvenih podova. Usmjereni smo na visokotehnološku proizvodnju i razvoj održivih rješenja od drva, spajajući lokalnu stručnost s globalnim standardima kvalitete. Naš tim čine motivirani i stručni profesionalci različitih profila – od proizvodnih i tehničkih do inženjerskih i stručnih administrativnih funkcija – koje povezuje zajednička strast prema inovacijama, kvaliteti i kontinuiranom unapređenju procesa. Trenutno intenzivno ulažemo u izgradnju najsuvremenijeg pogona za proizvodnju podova u Ogulinu te širimo kapacitete kroz nove proizvodne linije za Woodura podne obloge. Paralelno s razvojem proizvodnje, sustavno jačamo organizaciju kroz razvoj tehničkih, logističkih, administrativnih i ostalih ključnih podržavajućih funkcija. U nadolazećem razdoblju fokusirani smo na zapošljavanje, edukaciju i osposobljavanje zaposlenika svih profila, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke razine kvalitete procesa, proizvoda i održivog rasta cijele organizacije.

TVOJI KLJUČNI ZADACI

  • Održavanje i popravak radnih linija, strojeva i pribora,

  • Remont postrojenja,

  • Vođenje brige o elektroopremi,

  • Obavljanje sitnih popravaka i čišćenja elektro dijelova uređaja,

  • Sudjelovanje u demontaži i montaži elektroopreme prilikom redovitih i interventnih servisa i pri otklanjanju kvarova,

  • Praćenje rada uređaja i strojeva, ukazivanje na trenutne probleme i sudjelovanje u otklanjanju istih,

  • Pregled elektroopreme prema uputama (svakodnevno, tjedno, mjesečno) te ažurira iste.

OČEKUJEMO

  • SSS tehničkog ili drugog odgovarajućeg usmjerenja

  • Interes za otkrivanjem i rješavanjem problema

  • Komunikativna ste i organizirana osoba

  • Orijentiran na detalje i pouzdan zaposlenik

  • Profesionalizam, želju za učenjem i uklapanjem u korporativni sustav

  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Poticajno radno okruženje

  • Redovita primanja

  • Mjesečni dodatak za prehranu

  • Djelomično pokriveni troškovi prijevoza

  • Mjesečna nagrada za radne rezultate

  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno radno vrijeme uz probni rad od 6 mjeseci.

  • Početna plaća (tijekom probnog rada) 1.550€ BRUTO - mogućnost povećanja plaće ovisno o usvojenim znanjima, vještinama i samostalnosti u radu

  • Povećan broj dana godišnjeg odmora s obzirom na jubilarni staž i broj djece do 15 godina starosti

  • Božićnica, uskrsnica, regres, dar za djecu

  • Poklon bon za novorođenče

  • Jubilarne nagrade

  • Jasna mogućnost napredovanja kroz preuzimanje odgovornijih i kompleksnijih zadataka

  • Preuzimanje zanimljivih, izazovnih ali istovremeno zahtjevnih i odgovornih poslovnih zadataka

  • Mogućnost stjecanja novih znanja i osobnog razvoja

  • Sigurno i stabilno radno okruženja

  • Ravnotežu privatnog i poslovnog života

  • Mentorska podrška

  • Svježe voće za zaposlenike

  • Dva besplatna topla napitka dnevno po zaposleniku

  • Mogućnost punjenja električnih automobila (punionica na lokaciji)

  • Osigurana i profesionalno održavana radna odjeća (pranje i zamjena organizirani od strane poslodavca)

  • Bonus za preporuke (kada zaposlenik preporuči novog zaposlenika koji se zaposli)

POČETAK RADA I RADNO VRIJEME

  • Početak rada novih zaposlenika je 1. prosinca 2026.

  • Radi se u turnusima od 12 sati, od ponedjeljka do petka, uz rotaciju tri smjene.
