Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Lead Game Programmer
description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here’s what that looks like day to day

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

  • Our working language is English.

We offer

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

  • Pension plan and private health insurance.

  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

title: HR Country Manager Denmark
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

title: Work in the evenings and earn extra – Join Imerco’s Black Friday Team!
description:
Are you looking for a temporary evening job in November and December? Do you enjoy being physically active, working at a fast pace, and being part of a great team? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for the evening shift at Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4-5 evening shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6. The training will take place in the beginning of November.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

Detta söker vi:

We are looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys routine-based and independent work

  • Has a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Is reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for their shifts

  • Is physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the shift

  • Has good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Is available for 4 evening shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Is available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking, dependable, and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We offer an exciting temporary evening position in a well-established retail company, where you will become part of a friendly and supportive team. You will gain valuable warehouse experience, work in a structured environment with clearly defined tasks, and have the opportunity to earn extra money during the busy Christmas season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour, in addition to which evening and weekend supplements are provided.

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

  • Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

  • Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

  • Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

  • Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

  • Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.  

What you will bring: 

  • 10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

  • A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

  • Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

  • Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

  • An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

  • A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity. 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit. 

Application process 

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, People & Organisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel. All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered. 

Closing date for applications: Wednesday 11th November 2026   

Further information  

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Rabea Rehman, Associate | Executive Search at Korn Ferry, E: DRC_PO@KornFerry.com  

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo. 

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

title: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

  • Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

  • Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

  • Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

  • Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

  • Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

  • Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

  • Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

  • Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

  • Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Zhanyun WangDIAS ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail:  zwa@igt.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 12, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is in January 2026. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Pattern Design Manager
description:
Are you passionate about pattern design and motivated by bringing out the best in others? Do you enjoy taking the lead, driving projects forward and finding better ways of working, without losing touch with the craft you love?

Whether you're an experienced manager or looking to take your first step into leadership, at SELECTED you'll have the opportunity to lead a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants across menswear and womenswear while staying hands-on with pattern development.

YOUR TEAMYou'll become part of SELECTED's creative environment, where pattern design plays an important role in bringing our collections to life.Working closely with colleagues in Design and Buying, you and your team will turn design ideas into well-constructed garments, finding the right balance between creative intentions, fit, quality and commercial considerations.With responsibilities spanning both menswear and womenswear, you'll work with different perspectives and priorities, helping create a shared approach and strong collaboration across the two areas.

YOUR ROLEYou'll take responsibility for the team's performance and development while continuing to work hands-on with pattern development within your own product category.Beyond the day-to-day leadership, you'll drive projects, bring structure to shared priorities and help develop the technical standards and processes behind our collections. Your experience will be important in guiding decisions, solving technical challenges and ensuring progress across menswear and womenswear.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and developing a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants, supporting their individual growth and performance.

  • Taking hands-on responsibility for pattern development within your own product category, including fittings and technical adjustments.

  • Driving projects and coordinating priorities across menswear and womenswear.

  • Developing pattern design processes and technical standards to improve fit, construction and consistency.

  • Working closely with Design and Buying to find solutions that meet both creative and commercial needs.

  • Exploring and implementing digital pattern-making and 3D development tools where they can improve our work.

YOUR BENEFITSAt SELECTED, you'll be part of an international fashion business with high ambitions and a genuine interest in doing things better. We work across disciplines, challenge each other's thinking and believe that good ideas can come from anywhere. It's an environment where you're encouraged to contribute your perspective and make your experience count.We also recognise that doing great work doesn't mean working the same way every day. You'll have flexibility in planning your work and the opportunity to work from home when your responsibilities allow it, balancing time with your colleagues and the freedom to organise your own day.

YOUR PROFILEYou know your craft and enjoy using your experience to make others better. You're comfortable taking responsibility, bringing structure to projects and making decisions, even when different perspectives and priorities need to be considered.For us, your ability and motivation to lead matter more than whether you've held a management title before. You might already have experience managing a team, or you might be an experienced specialist ready to take on your first formal leadership role. What matters is that you can provide clear direction, involve others and create an environment where people can develop and deliver strong results together.

We imagine that you bring:

  • Solid experience in pattern design and garment construction within the fashion industry, including a strong understanding of fit, silhouettes and technical garment development.

  • The ability to plan, coordinate and drive projects involving different stakeholders.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to navigate different perspectives and priorities.

  • A structured approach to your work and an interest in improving existing methods.

  • An interest in digital pattern-making and 3D garment development.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Manja Ann Jacobsen on + 45 52 15 37 30. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 26 November 2026.  We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad, when we find the right candidate.

description:
Native French speaker, fully remote

Work tasks: Condor Automation is a growing company selling to industrial customers all over Europe. We help factories keep their machines running by finding the automation parts they urgently need: PLCs, HMIs, drives, servo drives, motors, electronic boards and sensors from brands such as Siemens, Omron, Allen Bradley, Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Yaskawa, Schneider and ABB. Our speciality is the obsolete and hard-to-find parts that local distributors can't supply. We are looking for an ambitious French-speaking Sales Executive to help us grow in France and Belgium. Koos meeskonnaga erinevate tööstusseadmete ja nende komponentide väljatöötamine ning projekteerimine Solid Edge tarkvaraga. - Projekteeritud detailide edastamine alltöövõtjatele hinnapäringuks. - Tehnilise dokumentatsiooni koostamine nagu varuosa listid projekteeritud seadmetele. - Hinnapäringute edastamine komponentide tarnijatele. - Tööjooniste koostamine töökoja poolele. - Projekteeritud plasttoodete printimine 3D plasti printeritega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Võimalust õppida ja täiendada ennast kogu masinaehitusega seonduvalt; püsivat töökohta; kaasaegseid töötingimusi; vahelduvat tööd.

Muud nõuded: Kindlasti eelnev kogemus Solid Edge tarkvara kasutamisel.Kokkupuude ja teadmised tehnika valdkonnas.

title: Autoplekksepp
description:
Tööülesanded: • Sõidukite kerede remont, taastamine ja roostekahjustuste kõrvaldamine.• Vanemate sõidukite keredetailide taastamine ja vajadusel uute detailide valmistamine. • Puuduvate või kahjustatud plekkdetailide valmistamine näidise või olemasoleva kereosa järgi. • Pleki lõikamine, painutamine, vormimine, sobitamine ja keevitamine. • Roostetanud kereosade eemaldamine ning asendamine uute või omavalmistatud detailidega. • Keredetailide täpne sobitamine ja kvaliteetne viimistlemine. • Iseseisev töö planeerimine ning sobivate remondi- ja taastamislahenduste leidmine. Töö eeldab head plekitööoskust, tehnilist taiplikkust, täpsust ja loomingulist lähenemist. Oluline on oskus valmistada keredetaile ka olukorras, kus valmis varuosi ei ole saadaval.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Suurepäraseid töötingimusi – korralikud, avarad ja hästi varustatud tööruumid, kus on mugav ja meeldiv töötada.• Tipptasemel töövahendeid – sinu käsutuses on MIG/MAG- ja TIG-keevitusseadmed, inglise ratas, Power Hammer, painutuspingid ning palju muud professionaalset varustust. • Põnevaid ja väljakutseid pakkuvaid projekte – võimalust taastada vanu autosid, valmistada erilahendusi ja teha tõelist meistritööd. • Sõbralikku ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda – töötad koos inimestega, kes hindavad head huumorit, üksteise abistamist ja kvaliteetset tööd. • Vabadust oma oskusi rakendada – hindame iseseisvat mõtlemist, nutikaid lahendusi ja meisterlikkust. • Väga head teenimisvõimalust – oskame hinnata head töömeest ning oleme valmis kvaliteetse ja tulemusliku töö eest maksma väärilist tasu. Kui sulle meeldib oma kätega midagi erilist luua, hindad häid tööriistu ja tahad näha oma töö üle uhkust tundmist väärt tulemust, siis meie juures on sul selleks kõik võimalused!

Muud nõuded: Millist inimest oma meeskonda ootame?Täpset ja põhjalikku – hindad kvaliteeti, pöörad tähelepanu detailidele ja tunned uhkust oma töö üle. Tehniliselt taiplikku ja leidlikku – oskad iseseisvalt mõelda, probleeme lahendada ja vajadusel nutikaid lahendusi välja töötada. Kannatlikku ja järjekindlat – mõistad, et kvaliteetne taastamistöö nõuab aega, pühendumist ja täpsust. Iseseisvat ja vastutustundlikku – oskad oma tööd planeerida, võtad vastutuse tulemuse eest ja pead kokkulepetest kinni. Õpihimulist ja arenemissooviga – tunned huvi uute töövõtete vastu ja soovid oma meisterlikkust pidevalt täiendada. Positiivset ja meeskonnahingega – oled sõbralik, koostööaldis ja aitad kaasa heale töökeskkonnale. Kõige olulisem on, et sul oleks tõeline huvi autode taastamise ja plekitöö vastu, head käelised oskused ning soov teha tööd, mille üle saad ise uhkust tunda.

Work tasks: Main areas of work:- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 0.5 - 1.0

title: Network Engineer (m/w/d) (Techniker/in - Informatik (Netzwerktechnologie)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
description: Ihre Vorteile:- Internationale Projekte in einem sicherheitsrelevanten Umfeld- Moderne Netzwerktechnologien- Langfristige Perspektive in einem abwechslungsreichen ProjektumfeldIhre Aufgaben:- Planung, Konfiguration und Administration komplexer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen- Betrieb und Optimierung von Routing- und Switching-Lösungen- Konfiguration und Management von Firewalls- Fehleranalyse und Troubleshooting in produktiven Umgebungen- Unterstützung bei Infrastrukturmigrationen und Rollouts- Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams vor Ort- Erstellung technischer DokumentationenIhre Qualifikationen:- Erfahrung als Network Engineer- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Routing- und Switching-Technologien- Praxiserfahrung mit Enterprise-Firewalls- Idealerweise Zertifizierungen wie CCNA, CCNP oder vergleichbar- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse- Hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft- Sicherheitsüberprüfung Ü2 vorhanden oder realisierbarÜber Hays:Der Bereich IT ist unsere Kernkompetenz, auf deren Grundlage sich Hays entwickelt hat. Wir sind das größte privatwirtschaftlich organisierte IT-Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen in Deutschland und haben für jede Karrierestufe das passende Angebot – egal ob Sie an Vakanzen in agilen KMUs oder starken DAX-Konzernen interessiert sind. Wir beherrschen die komplette IT-Klaviatur von Support bis zur Softwarearchitektur oder Digitalisierung – dank unseres umfangreichen Portfolios ist für jeden etwas dabei. So konnten wir in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten im Rahmen einer Life-Long-Partnerschaft unzählige Fach- und Führungskräfte aus der IT dabei unterstützen, die Weichen für eine erfolgreiche Karriere zu stellen. Unser Beratungsteam ist spezialisiert und somit in der Lage, auf Ihre Wünsche und Vorstellungen einzugehen und Sie auf Bewerbungsgespräche und Vertragsverhandlungen bestens vorzubereiten. Probieren Sie es aus und erfahren Sie, was der Markt Ihnen zu bieten hat – völlig kostenfrei, diskret und unverbindlich! Wir freuen uns auf Sie.

title: Kundmottagare / Servicerådgivare sökes till Håwe-bil Ab
description: Vill du arbeta med människor, bilar och service i ett företag där kvalitet, yrkesstolthet och kundnöjdhet står i fokus? Då kan du vara den vi söker!Håwe-bil Ab söker nu en kundmottagare / servicerådgivare som vill bli en viktig del av vårt team. Som kundmottagare är du länken mellan kunden och verkstaden. Du ansvarar för att kundens ärende hanteras professionellt från första kontakt till färdigt verkstadsarbete. Rollen kräver både god servicekänsla, organisatorisk förmåga och framför allt **en god förståelse för bilar och deras funktion.**Vi är en auktoriserad verkstad för Mazda, Kia, Mitsubishi, Peugeot, Citroën och Opel.**Vi söker dig som:**- Har goda kunskaper om bilar, deras funktion, teknik och uppbyggnad. Du behöver ha en grundläggande teknisk förståelse och kunna sätta dig in i olika typer av fordonsproblem och servicebehov. - Har ett genuint intresse för fordon och fordonsbranschen. - Är serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och har ett professionellt och trevligt bemötande. - Har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med både kunder, mekaniker och kollegor. - Är noggrann, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. - Trivs med att arbeta i ett stundtals högt tempo och har förmåga att prioritera. - Har god datorvana. Erfarenhet av verkstadssystem är meriterande. - Har erfarenhet av kundservice, kundmottagning eller servicerådgivning, gärna inom fordonsbranschen. **Fordonskunskap är en mycket viktig del av tjänsten.** Fordonsteknisk utbildning eller praktisk erfarenhet av arbete med bilar är därför särskilt meriterande. Har du exempelvis arbetat som bilmekaniker, fordonstekniker eller på annat sätt skaffat dig goda praktiska kunskaper om bilar ser vi det som en stor fördel.**Arbetsuppgifter:**- Ta emot kunder och boka in service, reparationer och verkstadsbesök. - Vara kundens huvudsakliga kontaktperson genom hela verkstadsbesöket. - Ta emot och förstå kundernas beskrivningar av fel, problem och servicebehov. - Ha en dialog med mekaniker och tekniker kring felsökning, åtgärder och planering av arbeten. - Planera och koordinera verkstadsarbeten. - Upprätta arbetsordrar och hantera kundärenden. - Informera kunder om arbetets gång, kostnader och leveranstider. - Säkerställa en hög nivå av kundservice och kundnöjdhet. **Vi erbjuder:**- En varierande och utvecklande tjänst med stort eget ansvar. - Ett stabilt och lokalt förankrat företag med lång erfarenhet inom bilbranschen. - Ett trevligt och professionellt team. - Möjlighet att utvecklas och bredda dina kunskaper inom fordonsbranschen. - Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är på heltid och tillsvidare.Ange löneanspråk i din ansökan.Frågor?Kontakta platschef Farbod ChehrehvaniTelefon: +358 18 329927 E-post: farbod@hawe.axVälkommen med din ansökan!Skicka din ansökan och CV till:Farbod Chehrehvani, platschef farbod@hawe.ax Telefon: +358 18 329927Urval sker löpande och tjänsten tillsätts så snart rätt person hittas.Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: SAS DIS Lead Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced SAS Data Integration Studio (DIS) Lead Developer, preferably with the capability and experience to also work in a Solution Architect role. The consultant will be responsible for the architecture and technical design of SAS 9.x data integration, data warehouse and data mart solutions. The role includes designing and developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SAS Data Integration Studio, Base SAS and SQL, translating business, reporting, regulatory and operational requirements into solution designs, and defining data models, transformation rules and reusable technical standards.

Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture and Design:
· Own the architecture and technical design of SAS 9.x data integration, data warehouse and data mart solutions.
· Translate business, reporting, regulatory and operational requirements into logical and physical solution designs.
· Design and develop robust ETL and ELT pipelines using SAS Data Integration Studio, Base SAS and SQL.
· Define source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, data flows, dependencies, restart points and error-handling patterns.
· Design and develop and guide conceptual, logical and physical data models, including dimensional, normalized or vault-style models where appropriate.
· Establish reusable standards for job structures, naming, parameterization, logging, auditing, exception handling and documentation.
· Evaluate architectural trade-offs involving data movement, database pushdown, SAS processing, storage, scheduling and downstream consumption.

Required Experience:
· SQL (mandatory)
· ETL (mandatory)
· Databricks · SAS, DI studio (mandatory)
· SAS Base (mandatory)

Background check needed will be informed if candidate is chosen.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience designing and developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SAS Data Integration Studio (SAS 9.x)?*
- Do you have strong practical experience with Base SAS and SQL, including complex data transformations and data integration?*
- Have you previously been responsible for the technical architecture and solution design of SAS-based data warehouses or data marts?*
- Do you have practical experience working with Databricks in data engineering or data integration projects?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Language requirements:
· Finnish - Considered as an advantage
· English - Fluent (mandatory)

Start date: 01.12.2026
End date: 31.05.2027 
Scope/hours per week: 100% allocation
Location: Finland. Work is done remotely with visits to customer premises. Consultant should be in reasonable travel distance to Helsinki.

title: Vårdare
description: Vi söker en vårdare med närvårdarutbildning till Octavens verksamhetscenter. Arbetet är i allmän arbetstid, dagtid måndag-fredag.Octavens serviceenhet på Lästmakarvägen 19, är en svenskspråkig enhet som erbjuder dagverksamhet för personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 25 servicetagare i fem basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vårdare som vill bli en del av vårt team på åtta personer.Du kommer i först hand att jobba i en basgrupp som erbjuder sysselsättning i varierande former, men även enskilt med personer inom autismspektrumet. Du bör vara trygg i dig själv och din arbetsroll samt förstå innebörden av lågaffektivt bemötande. I arbetet ingår också hjälp och stöd i personlig vård. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av att lära dig om arbete med personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer så är du den rätta personen för oss. Vi erbjuder dig ett meningsfullt och varierande jobb med engagerade kollegor. Du får ta del av Helsingfors stads mångsidiga utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter samt personalförmåner som t.ex. kultur- och motionsförmåner, rabatt till kollektivtrafiken och cykelförmån. Vid behov hjälper vi dig att hitta en tjänstebostad. Läs mer om Helsingfors tjänstebostäder på adressen https://www.hel.fi/sv/boende/tjanstebostader/ansok-om-en-tjanstebostad.Närvårdares yrkesutbildning och registrering i Valviras centralregister över yrkesutbildade personer.Goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska samt nöjaktiga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finskaDen sökande ska före antagningsbeslutet förete företagshälsovårdens bedömning om sina förutsättningar att sköta uppgiften.Personen som blir vald till tjänsten måste före arbetsförhållandet börjar presentera arbetsgivaren med ett bevis på drogtest.I uppgiften krävs vaccineringsskydd enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar 48 §, samt utredning över tuberkulos enligt 55§.Den som blir vald till tjänsten bör innan hen tar emot tjänsten, uppvisa ett brottsregisterutdrag för dem som arbetar med personer med funktionsnedsättning (lagen om tillsyn över social- och hälsovårdstjänster 741/2023, 28 §).I uppgiften krävs att LOP/LOVe LOP-läkemedelstillståndet genomförs godkänt inom prövotiden.Vi räknar som en merit:Tidigare arbetserfarenhet inom branschen.Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet i vår arbetsgemenskap. Vi välkomnar sökande av olika åldrar och kön, personer med funktionsnedsättning samt personer som tillhör olika språkliga, kulturella eller eventuellt andra minoriteter. Vi strävar efter att garantera en lättillgänglig rekryteringsprocess för alla sökande. Om du behöver anpassningar eller har önskemål gällande tillgängligheten under ansökningsprocessen, kan du kontakta oss via e-post på: sotepe.monimuotoinen.rekrytointi@hel.fi. Meddelandena hanteras separat från den rekryterande enheten, och kontakten vidarebefordras inte till den rekryterande förpersonen utan den sökandes samtycke.

title: IOS and Android Engineers
description:
Were looking for an iOS Engineer to help develop the features and functionality of the mobile app. More than two million users have downloaded and activated the app, so reliability, security and quality are central to our work.

Role #1
Youll work in an agile, cross-functional team, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, designers, backend developers and QA engineers. The iOS app is primarily built with Swift, with parts using RxSwift, SwiftUI and Combine.
 
What youll do:
- Develop and maintain high-quality features for the mobile app.
- Contribute to architectural discussions and identify dependencies between systems.
- Write clean, maintainable code and take part in code reviews.
- Build and maintain unit, integration and automated tests.
- Work closely with colleagues across disciplines to deliver a great user experience.

Requirements:
Role #1
- Experience developing mobile applications for iOS and a good understanding of the iOS SDK.
- Strong Swift and UIKit skills, and knowledge of modern iOS development practices.
- An understanding of software development best practices, including testing and writing high-quality code.
- A willingness to build and maintain test automation.
- Clear communication skills, a collaborative mindset and fluency in English.
- The ability to work with complex integrations and adapt to new technologies and ways of working.
Experience with RxSwift, SwiftUI, Combine and Xcode is beneficial.
 
Additional experience thats a plus: VIPER architecture, cybersecurity, accessibility, Splunk, loyalty programmes or banking.

Role #2
Were looking for an experienced Senior Android Engineer to take on the role of Lead Android Engineer for the mobile app. Youll help develop its features and functionality, while taking ownership of technical direction and supporting strong engineering practices across the team.
 
More than 2.5 million users have downloaded and activated the app, making reliability and quality essential. Youll work in an agile team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, designers, developers and QA engineers.
 
What youll do:
- Develop and maintain high-quality Android features for the mobile app.
- Guide architectural and technical decisions, and plan code maintenance and refactoring.
- Promote clean code, modern Android practices and testing, including unit, integration and UI tests.
- Help establish effective processes and create clear technical documentation.
- Take ownership of technical quality and share knowledge within the mobile competence community.

Role #2
- Strong experience developing mobile applications for Android.
- Strong Kotlin skills and experience with Jetpack Compose, RxJava, Dagger2 and custom UI.
- Knowledge of modern Android development practices, architecture and test-driven development.

title: Business Cutover Lead
description:
For our client, we are looking for a Business Cutover Lead.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Description: 
The Customer is currently implementing SAP S/4HANA as a core ERP system. The aim is to go live in May 2027. To support the go live preparations, the Customer is looking for an experienced Business Cutover Lead to join the programme team.
The Business Cutover Lead will ensure that the business transition from the legacy systems to the new solution at the go-live happens with minimal disruption to operations.
 
Main responsibilities of the Business Cutover Lead:
1. Business cutover planning: Develop and maintain the business cutover plan in coordination with the program streams including activities (in Jira), dependencies, owners, milestones, and timing.
2. Business readiness: Coordinate and track business readiness across streams including people/competence, processes, data, and controls/metrics.
3. Business Cutover execution management: Consolidate and report the business readiness status, unresolved issues, and risks to the Program Leadership. Support the Go/No-Go decisions. Communicate cutover schedules, responsibilities, decisions, and status to the stakeholders.
4. Hypercare and stabilisation: Coordinate business support during initial operations. Monitor critical processes with the set controls/metrics and in cooperation with the line management leading the change. Prioritise issues, coordinate the retirement of contingency tools and procedures, and support the transition to business-as-usual operations.
5. Cutover rehearsals: Coordinate the business participation in cutover rehearsals, validate business activities, timings, dependencies, resources, and contingency procedures, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into the final cutover plan.
 
Required skills and d experience:
 Extensive experience in a business cutover role: Has led business cutover activities in several SAP S/4HANA greenfield implementations (private cloud solution)
 Deep understanding of cutover activities and methodology
 Proactive and ability to drive activities independently to completion
 Strong project management skills

title: Senior Finance Data & AI engineer
description: **About the role** As a Senior Finance Data & AI Engineer, you will build and develop Finance-owned data, AI and application solutions across areas such as closing, controlling, tax, treasury and financial transactional services.Embedded within Finance, you will work closely with different finance teams to turn business challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You will also provide technical leadership for the teams engineering output by establishing common standards and reusable patterns, supporting colleagues and taking ownership of the most complex and business-critical solutions.**Key responsibilities**- Partner with finance teams to translate business needs into scalable data, AI and application solutions, leading complex and cross-functional builds from concept to production. - Design and build data pipelines, machine learning and GenAI solutions, AI agents and user-facing applications using Databricks, Azure or other relevant technologies - Own the full solution lifecycle, including architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, model evaluation and retraining. - Establish reusable engineering and application patterns, including pipeline templates, agent frameworks, shared components and UI design systems. - Set and promote standards for code quality, testing, MLOps, security, maintainability, accessibility and usability, while contributing to platform and technology decisions. - Mentor colleagues, conduct technical reviews and act as an escalation point for complex builds, using AI-enabled development tools to improve delivery speed and quality. **What we are looking for**- At least five years of experience in data, AI or software engineering, including technical leadership or architecture ownership across a solution portfolio. - Strong expertise in Python, SQL, data engineering, machine learning, GenAI and LLM/agent frameworks, together with experience building production-grade applications. - Hands-on experience with Databricks and Azure, including CI/CD, Azure DevOps or equivalent, and Data/ML/AI Ops practices. - Strong application and front-end architecture capabilities, including reusable component design, design systems and maintainable user interfaces at scale. - A bachelors or masters degree in computer science, data/AI engineering, software engineering or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Strong stakeholder skills are essential; finance process Knowledge and relevant Azure, Databricks or AI certifications are considered advantages. Agile scrum master experience considered advantage**Growth opportunities**This role offers the opportunity to develop into a technical or delivery lead covering Finances broader engineering portfolio. From there, the career path may progress toward senior architecture and technical leadership, platform and solution strategy, or broader end-to-end solution ownership.**Please apply latest: 29th of November****For more information please contact:** Senior Manager – Finance Business Analytics Nenad Veselinovic **via phone +358407795483 during contact hours**: 20th Nov 11-12 or 27th Nov 11-12 EET.**The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment**

title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja, Turku

Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa, työaikojen kuitenkin ollessa työskentelykohteista riippuen joustavia. Työkielenä käytetään suomea, joten suomen kielen taito on ehdoton.
